title: Star Citizen Alpha 4.8.2
startrackerNotes: Awarded X aUEC HUD lines are often missing from Game.log on newer builds. StarTracker falls back to wiki payout estimates for known contracts.
Loadout snapshots now parse AttachmentReceived lines when you spawn or swap gear.
Foxwell defend and Headhunters ambush contracts get local payout estimates when cash lines are absent.
playerNotes: Check the Commodities and Mining tabs for UEX buy and sell prices per SCU.
Smuggler routes tab lists curated illegal trade runs with commodity hints.
